record.name: Agent
record.description: You have served as an agent for a government, corporation, or faction, operating in the shadows to advance your organization's interests. Whether as a spy, diplomat, or covert operative, you've learned to navigate complex political landscapes and gather intelligence through subtle means.

feature.name: Safe Haven
feature.description: As a faction agent, you have access to a secret network of supporters and operatives who can provide assistance on your adventures. You know a set of secret signs and passwords you can use to identify such operatives, who can provide you with access to a hidden safe house, free room and board, or assistance in finding information. These agents never risk their lives for you or risk revealing their true identities.

effects.notes: Access to faction safe houses and information networks

traits: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
I am incredibly slow to trust.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation.
I use multisyllabic words that others don't understand.
I have a strong sense of fair play.
I am haunted by memories of war.
I don't talk about the thing that torments me.
I idolize a particular hero of my faction and refer to them constantly.
ideals: Duty. My duty is to my faction, and I will do whatever it takes to fulfill it.
Independence. I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do.
Power. I will do whatever it takes to become powerful.
Peace. I will not be the one to draw my weapon first.
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy.
bonds: I'm on the run from a crime lord I crossed.
I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
I am searching for my former master.
I am protecting a secret that could endanger the galaxy.
I am the last of my line, and I must not fail.
flaws: I can't resist a pretty face.
When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between my friends and my mission, I'll choose my mission.
I am overly critical of others' flaws.
I am haunted by visions of the future.
My pride sometimes gets the better of me.
